summary:
We developed a children's story book based on our research. It follows a pirate that is a sutainability warrior that finds all the unused equipment and they tell them their 'life story' then they donate their best part to be part of a recycled future Mars equipment. 
He eventually uses it to find sustainable water on Mars and set up life there in Foreverland :)
details:
It is an animated children's book

It makes old space equipment relevant and tangible to children. It brings in an element of magic and sustainability and the concept of possibility - what can be repurposed to create new life?
